lessons.title: Lesson 1: Health problems and advice with More / Less
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Lesson 1: Health problems and advice with More / Less.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn.

concepts.definition: Used to give direct health advice or instructions. Use 'More' for good habits and 'Less' for bad habits.
concepts.example: Eat more vegetables and fresh fruits. / Spend less time on electronic screens.
concepts.essence: Short, powerful imperative structures help reinforce healthy lifestyle choices.

rules.statement: Coordinating conjunctions (FANBOYS: and, but, or, so)
rules.meaning: 'And' joins similar ideas; 'But' shows contrast; 'Or' gives an alternative; 'So' expresses a result.
rules.example: I had a sunburn, so I put on some aloe vera cream. / He likes sports, but he is lazy.
rules.essence: A comma usually precedes the coordinating conjunction when linking two independent clauses.

workedExamples.prompt: Combine two sentences using a suitable conjunction: 'She feels tired. She stayed up late last night.'
steps: Step 1: Identify the relationship: Staying up late is the reason, feeling tired is the result.
Step 2: Use 'so' for result or 'because' for reason: 'She stayed up late last night, so she feels tired.'
workedExamples.answer: She stayed up late last night, so she feels tired.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using 'less' with countable plural nouns instead of 'fewer'.
commonMistakes.why: Use 'less' for uncountable nouns (less sugar, less fast food) and 'fewer' for countable nouns (fewer candies).
